verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Saad wal-qur'aani dhidh-dhikr
Balil-ladheena kafaroo fee izzatin wa shiqaaq
Kam ahlaknaa min qablihim min qarnin fanaadaw walaata heena manaas
Wa ajiboo an jaa'ahum mundhirun minhum wa qaalal-kaafiroona haadhaa saahirun kadhdhaab
Aja'alal-aalihata ilahan waahidan inna haadhaa lashay'un ujaab
Wantalaqal-mala'u minhum anim-shoo wasbiroo alaa aalihatikum inna haadhaa lashay'un yuraad
Maa sami'naa bihadhaa fil-millatil-aakhirati in haadhaa illakh-tilaaq
A'uunzila alayhidh-dhikru min bayninaa bal hum fee shakkin min dhikree bal lammaa yadhooqoo adhaab
Am indahum khazaa'inu rahmati rabbikal-azeezil-wahhaab
Am lahum mulkus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumaa falyartaqoo fil-asbaab
Jundun maa hunaalika mahzoomun minal-ahzaab
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin wa aadun wa fir'awnu dhul-awtaad
Wa thamoodu wa qawmu lootin wa ashaabul-aykati ulaa'ikal-ahzaab
In kullun illaa kadhdhabar-rusula fahaqqa iqaab
Wa maa yanzuru haa'ulaa'i illaa sayhatan waahidatan maa lahaa min fawaaq
Wa qaaloo rabbanaa ajjil lanaa qittanaa qabla yawmil-hisaab
Isbir alaa maa yaqooloona wadhkur abdanaa daawooda dhal-aydi innahu awwaab
Innaa sakhkharnal-jibaala ma'ahu yusabbihna bil-ashiyyi wal-ishraaq
Wat-tayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwaab
Wa shadadnaa mulkahu wa aataynaahul-hikmata wa faslal-khitaab
Wa hal ataaka naba'ul-khasmi idh tasawwarul-mihraab
Idh dakhaloo alaa daawooda fafazi'a minhum qaaloo laa takhaf khasmaani baghaa ba'dunaa alaa ba'din fahkum baynanaa bil-haqqi wa laa tushtit wahdinaa ilaa sawaa'is-siraat
Inna haadhaa akhee lahu tis'un wa tis'oona na'jatan wa liya na'jatun waahidatun faqaala akfilneehaa wa azzanee fil-khitaab

Qaala laqad zalamaka bisu'uaali na'jatika ilaa ni'aajihi wa inna katheeran minal-khulataa'i layabghee ba'duhum alaa ba'din illal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa qaleelun maa hum wa zanna daawoodu annamaa fatannaahu fastaghfara rabbahu wa kharra raaki'an wa anaab
Faghafarnaa lahu dhaalika wa inna lahu indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma'aab

Yaa daawoodu innaa ja'alnaaka khaleefatan fil-ardi fahkum baynan-naasi bil-haqqi wa laa tattabi'il-hawaa fayudillaka an sabeelillaahi innal-ladheena yadilloona an sabeelillaahi lahum adhaabun shadeedun bimaa nasoo yawmal-hisaab
Wa maa khalaqnas-samaa'a wal-arda wa maa baynahumaa baatilan dhaalika zannul-ladheena kafaroo fawaylun lilladheena kafaroo minan-naar
Am naj'alul-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati kal-mufsideena fil-ardi am naj'alul-muttaqeena kal-fujjaar
Kitaabun anzalnaahu ilayka mubaarakun liyaddabbaroo aayaatihi wa liyatadhakkara ulul-albaab
Wa wahabnaa lidaawooda sulaymaana ni'mal-abdu innahu awwaab
Idh urida alayhi bil-ashiyyis-saafinaatul-jiyaad
Faqaala innee ahbabtu hubbal-khayri an dhikri rabbee hattaa tawaarat bil-hijaab
Ruddoohaa alayya fatafiqa mashan bis-sooqi wal-a'naaq
Wa laqad fatannaa sulaymaana wa alqaynaa alaa kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaab
Qaala rabbi ighfir lee wa hab lee mulkan laa yanbaghee li'hadin min ba'dee innaka antal-wahhaab
Fasakhkharnaa lahur-reeha tajree bi-amrihi rukhaa'an haythu asaab
Wash-shayaateena kulla bannaa'in wa ghawwaas
Wa aakhareena muqarraneena fil-asfaad
Haadhaa ataa'uunaa famnun aw amsik bighayri hisaab
Wa inna lahu indanaa lazulfaa wa husna ma'aab
Wadhkur abdanaa ayyooba idh naadaa rabbahu annee massanish-shaytaanu binusbin wa adhaab
Urkud birijlika haadhaa mughtasalun baaridun wa sharaab
Wa wahabnaa lahu ahlahu wa mithlahum ma'ahum rahmatan minnaa wa dhikraa li'wlil-albaab
Wa khudh biyadika dighthan fadrib bihi wa laa tahnath innaa wa jadnaahu saabiran ni'mal-abdu innahu awwaab
Wadhkur ibaadanaa ibraaheema wa ishaaqa wa ya'qooba ulil-aydee wal-absaar
Innaa akhlasnaahum bikhaalisatin dhikrad-daar
Wa innahum indanaa laminal-mustafaynal-akhyaar
Wadhkur ismaa'eela wal-yasa'a wa dhal-kifli wa kullun minal-akhyaar
Haadhaa dhikrun wa inna lilmuttaqeena lahusna ma'aab
Jannaati adnin mufattahatan lahumul-abwaab
Muttaki'eena feehaa yad'oona feehaa bifaakihatin katheeratin wa sharaab
Wa indahum qaasiraatut-tarfi atraab
Haadhaa maa too'adoona liyawmil-hisaab
Inna haadhaa larizqunaa maa lahu min nafaad
Haadhaa wa inna lit-taagheena lasharra ma'aab
Jahannama yaslawnahaa fabi'sal-mihaad
Haadhaa falyadhooqoohu hameemun wa ghassaaq
Wa aakharu min shaklihi azwaaj
Haadhaa fawjun muqtahimun ma'akum laa marhaban bihim innahum saalun-naar
Qaaloo bal antum laa marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lanaa fabi'sal-qaraar
Qaaloo rabbanaa man qaddama lanaa haadhaa fazidhu adhaaban di'fan fin-naar
Wa qaaloo maa lanaa laa naraa rijaalan kunnaa na'udduhum minal-ashraar
Aattakhadhnaahum sikhriyyan am zaaghat anhumul-absaar
Inna dhaalika lahaqqun takhaasumu ahlin-naar
Qul innamaa anaa mundhirun wa maa min ilaahin illaa Allaahul-waahidul-qahhaar
Rabbus-samaawaati wal-ardi wa maa baynahumal-azeezul-ghaffaar
Qul huwa naba'un azeem
Antum anhu mu'ridoon
Maa kaana liya min ilmin bil-mala'il-a'laa idh yakhtasimoon
In yoohaa ilayya illaa annamaa anaa nadheerun mubeen
Idh qaala rabbuka lilmalaa'ikati innee khaaliqun basharan min teen
Fa-idhaa sawwaytuhu wa nafakhtu feehi min roohee faqa'oo lahu saajideen
Fasajadal-malaa'ikatu kulluhum ajma'oon
Illaa ibleesa istakbara wa kaana minal-kaafireen
Qaala yaa ibleesu maa mana'aka an tasjuda limaa khalaqtu biyadayya aastakbarta am kunta minal-aaleen
Qaala anaa khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min naarin wa khalaqtahu min teen
Qaala fakhruj minhaa fa-innaka rajeem
Wa inna alayka la'natee ilaa yawmid-deen
Qaala rabbi fa-anzirnee ilaa yawmi yub'athoon
Qaala fa-innaka minal-munzareen
Ilaa yawmil-waqtil-ma'loom
Qaala fabi'izzatika la-ughwiyannahum ajma'een
Illaa ibaadaka minhumul-mukhlaseen
Qaala fal-haqqu wal-haqqa aqool
La-amla'anna jahannama minka wa mimman tabi'aka minhum ajma'een
Qul maa as'alukum alayhi min ajrin wa maa anaa minal-mutakallifeen
In huwa illaa dhikrun lil-aalameen
Wa lata'lamunna naba'ahu ba'da heen
